cohort: Participants included mothers who gave birth and their fetuses/newborns at a maternity ward, specifically focusing on cases of perinatal death (fetuses >= 22 weeks/500g or newborns dying within 7 days) and their partners.
finding: The perinatal mortality rate was 44.2 per 1,000, with significant risk factors including maternal age, medical history, parity, and route of delivery, while HBP complications, respiratory distress, and prematurity were identified as common causes.
mod_finding: Route of delivery was identified as an associated risk factor for perinatal mortality.
